lines: But the task lies in determining the
teacher's scripture, and in the fitting concept
born of the scripture's chain of kin: that chain
is true-reason; called contemplation too — from
indistinctness, an existing thing is contemplated
as non-existent by being made distinct.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kiṃ tu guror āgamanirūpaṇe vyāpāraḥ āgamasya ca niḥśaṅkasajātīyatatprabandhaprasavanibandhanasamucitavikalpodaye vyāpāraḥ tathāvidhavikalpaprabandha eva sattarka iti uktaḥ sa eva ca bhāvanā bhaṇyate asphuṭatvāt bhūtam api artham abhūtam iva sphuṭatvāpādanena bhāvyate yayā iti
